events.title: Both league-leaders 맨체스터 유나이티드 and second-placed 아스널 drop points as they are both held, by 윔블던 and 사우샘프턴 respectively. Elsewhere, 리버풀 win the Merseyside derby 3–2, and 리즈 유나이티드 rack up their seventh win on the bounce–a club record–by beating 노팅엄 포리스트.

맨체스터 유나이티드 and 아스널, competing head to head for both the Premier League title and the FA Cup, draw 0–0 at Villa Park in the FA Cup semi-final . In other semi-final, at Old Trafford , two goals in extra time from Alan Shearer send 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 through to the final for the second year running and spell an end to 토트넘 홋스퍼's hopes of a cup double.

One of the most thrilling games so far this season sees 맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 아스널 2–1 in extra time in the FA Cup semi-final replay. United had taken the lead after 17th minutes thanks to 데이비드 베컴 , only for Dennis Bergkamp to equalise after 69 minutes. Bergkamp could have won the game for 아스널 with just a minute remaining, but Peter Schmeichel saved his penalty shot and forced extra time, in which 라이언 긱스 won it for United with a spectacular 109th-minute goal.

맨체스터 유나이티드 reach their first European Cup final for 31 years – and only their second of all time – by recording a 4–3 aggregate win over 유벤투스 . They won 3–2 in tonight's clash in Turin , having been 2–0 down at half-time. They drew 1–1 in the first leg at Old Trafford on 7 April.

UEFA rejects calls from English clubs for four, rather than three, Champions League qualification places to be available for next season's competition – this will only happen in the unlikely event of 맨체스터 유나이티드 winning the European Cup next month and finishing outside the top three of the Premier League.
노팅엄 포리스트's Premier League relegation is confirmed with a 2–0 defeat to 애스턴 빌라, after which manager Ron Atkinson announces that he will retire at the end of this season.

April draws to a close with 아스널 now leading the Premier League, but 맨체스터 유나이티드 are a point behind with a game in hand. 첼시 and 리즈 유나이티드 remain in distant contention, while the final European place is being contested by 애스턴 빌라, 웨스트햄 유나이티드, 미들즈브러, 더비 카운티, 리버풀 and 레스터 시티. 노팅엄 포리스트's inevitable relegation has now been confirmed, with 사우샘프턴, 찰턴 애슬레틱, 블랙번 로버스, 코번트리 시티, 에버턴 and 셰필드 웬즈데이 all in the battle of avoid going down as well. 선덜랜드 are definitely in the Premier League next season, as champions of Division One. 브래드퍼드 시티 and 입스위치 타운 are level on points in the race for second place, with 버밍엄 시티 now the only team who can catch either of them. 볼턴 원더러스 and 울버햄프턴 원더러스 complete the top six, but 왓퍼드 are pushing hard for a playoff place.
